results.title: Imaan, Hadi sent back to judicial custody hours after SC grants them bail
results.description: ISLAMABAD - Human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband Hadi Ali Chattha, hours after being granted bail by the Supreme Court, were sent back into custody on Thursday night after being produced before an anti-terrorism court in a separate case registered at the Kohsar police station.

results.title: PTI leader accuses govt of engineering transfer of cases
results.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Secretary General Salman Akram Raja on Thursday accused the government of engineering the transfer of cases concerning incarcerated party chief Imran Khan to the Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) to deny him justice.

results.title: Registering a Foreign Marriage in Thailand: Key Steps
results.description:
A wedding ceremony alone doesn’t create a legal marriage in Thailand. To legally marry, a foreign national and Thai national usually need to obtain an Affirmation of Freedom to Marry from the foreign partner’s embassy, translate it into Thai, have the translation legalized, and register the marriage at an amphur or khet.
